pages.title: Accessories
pages.text:
**Accessories** are worn beside your armor: rings, necklaces, hats, goggles, gloves, belts, backpacks, charms and more. They count on top of your armor.\
\
Open the **Accessories** screen with **G**, or with the small ring button at the top right of your picture in the inventory. Every accessory goes in that one screen.

**How many you can wear**

- Hat, eyes (goggles), face mask: 1 each
- Necklaces: 3
- Cape, back, body: 1 each
- Hands: 2, one per hand
- Shield: 1
- Rings: 10
- Belt, quiver, book, shoes: 1 each
- Charms: 3
- Gadgets: 3

A **pair of gloves** (Aether gloves, Sticky Gloves, Blazing Grips) takes both hands; a single claw or glove takes one.\
\
No two of the same item in one group, except rings and hands: up to 2 of the same. The limits hold however you put an item on, right-click included.\
\
Empty slots say what goes in them and how many you wear.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** hover a worn item and click the small **eye** in its corner to hide it on your character. A hidden item still works; the eye stays crossed out until you show it again.\
\
Shift-click an accessory in your inventory to put it on.
